title: social-messenger lane-run record extension
description: Extension block for one social-messenger lane run. The base record keeps lane, harness, correction loops with the protocol's attribution enum, hand-authored LOC, and diary; this extension adds LLP 0201 D2's milestone structure. A complete record embeds this object under 'socialMessenger' and validates against the sibling composed run-record.schema.json. Published efficiency claims read the per-milestone authoring clocks only; the grading, replay, and M7 clocks are separately recorded and never included in the authoring statistic (LLP 0201 D2).

extensionVersion.description: Version 2 requires an execution-ordered terminal boundary for every attempted milestone.

orientation.description: Bounded lane steering generated before the agent starts. This block is additive to the milestone authoring clocks: deliveredBytes is context delivery, while the sibling firstProductEdit field is the cumulative harness-native orientation-token snapshot and MUST NOT be added to milestones.M1.authoring.tokens.

selectedSkills.description: Stable skill IDs selected for the lane before M1; the lane-local packet is the bounded projection of this set.

uniqueBytes.description: Unique UTF-8 steering bytes loaded before the first product edit.

deliveredBytes.description: Delivered UTF-8 steering bytes after the packet/AGENTS dedup rule; separately reported from authoring tokens and bounded by LLP 0259.

runScope.description: reduced = M1-M3 (per-dimension scores only, no overall total, no L4 evidence); full = M1-M8 plus the scale replay and the M7 fresh session (M8 runs in the continuous session after M6; numbering is identity, not execution order).

capFamily.description: Cap family per LLP 0201 D2: cap families enumerate the model matrix exactly. The wall cap is keyed by milestone and shared by every lane in every family of a wave; the token cap is keyed by (cap family, milestone). kimi-advisory and grok-advisory are cap-advisory: wall caps recorded for reference, token caps recorded as inapplicable, never enforced, with the P2 safety limits as hard stops.

deploymentPosture.description: The lane's backend deployment posture, a pinned record field per the replay contract - postures differ across backends, which is why O5 is a scale-safety gate and never a cross-backend speed comparison.

milestones.description: Per-milestone execution record. Reduced runs record M1-M3; full runs record M1-M8. Full-run milestones stay in the completeness denominator regardless of status.

termination.description: Lane termination. Two consecutive capability-failure/aborted results (blocks do not count) end the lane; milestones after a termination record not-run. The reason is orthogonal to the status machine. When M8 never runs, the lane's authoring wall ends at the last runnable milestone's terminal status.

terminatedEarly.description: True when the lane ended before completing its scope.

reason.description: Orthogonal termination reason, free-form but stable phrasing preferred, e.g. 'two-consecutive-capability-failures', 'environment', 'operator', 'safety-limit'. Null when the lane ran to the end of its scope.

afterMilestone.description: The last milestone that reached a terminal status before termination; null when not terminated early.

compaction.description: Context-compaction accounting (LLP 0201 D1): a 1-3M-token session will compact; the harness's compaction policy is pinned per family and compaction events are logged, so within-family variance attributable to context loss can be inspected rather than guessed at.

policy.description: The harness's compaction policy identifier for this family, pinned per family in the wave record.

events.description: Every compaction event during the lane, in order.

milestone.description: Which milestone's authoring (or the replay) was in progress when compaction fired.

contextTokensBefore.description: Context size at compaction where the harness exposes it; null otherwise.

meteringProvenance.description: Driver-stamped metering custody: the complete builder session tree, receipt identities, source hashes, terminal-boundary artifact, wall-clock origin, and recorded skew bound used by the join.

unavailableReason.description: Stable reason code when the native usage tree is unavailable; null for a native metered lane.

maxSkewMillis.description: Measured maximum cross-clock skew. Drivers must use a nonzero bound when usage and boundary stamps come from different processes; zero is valid only with evidence that one process and clock stamps both channels.

coverageManifest.description: The lane's assertion-coverage manifest (LLP 0201 D2): maps every suite-required assertion (by stable ID from benchmarks/schema/social-messenger/assertions.json) to a test. A milestone's suite pass is honored only if this manifest validates. The grader later spot-verifies the mapping is honest; the spot-verification verdict lives in the grader report, and a dishonest mapping adjudicates the milestone (see milestoneRecord.adjudication).

path.description: Repo-relative path to the lane's coverage manifest.

sha256.description: Content hash of the manifest as validated.

validated.description: Harness validation result: every suite-required assertion in the run's scope maps to a test.

assertionManifest.description: Pin of the frozen assertion-ID manifest version this run was graded against.

clocks.description: The separately recorded clocks (LLP 0201 D2). Per-milestone authoring clocks live in milestones.*.authoring; this object records the non-authoring clocks. None of these are ever included in the authoring statistic.

grading.description: Grader execution clock, per grading session (a re-run or other-family regrade appends a session).

dollarCost.description: Per-grader-session dollar cost at the pinned model's published prices; recorded, not a claim statistic.

outcome.description: grader-abort = the grader's own environment or tooling failed twice (one re-run allowed); not a lane defect.

replay.description: Scale-replay clock (full runs, after M6). Exhausting the replay cap scores O5 - never the lane's completion statuses. Probe wall time at checkpoints is excluded from the replay cap.

capSeconds.description: The replay's own wall cap, pilot-calibrated at P3.

capFractionUsed.description: wallSeconds / capSeconds; an O5 band input (>0.8 caps at 60; <=0.5 required for 90).

probeWallSecondsExcluded.description: Checkpoint-probe wall time excluded from the cap.

m7Session.description: The M7 fresh session's own recorded clock (its per-milestone authoring detail also lands in milestones.M7.authoring). M7 runs against the pre-replay starter state under the same aid condition as the lane it continues, and writes its own diary entry and essay under the same essay-before-numbers sequencing.

preM7SnapshotPath.description: The pre-M7 snapshot exported through the M6 custom-client API over the pinned message field manifest, taken before the session starts.

preExistingCountStructures.description: Whether the pre-M7 schema already carried count structures (keeps B8's forced-migration signal honest).

diary.description: Path to the M7 session's diary entry.

dollarCost.description: Dollar cost per lane, computed from tokens at the pinned models' published prices; recorded, not a claim statistic (it matters once the model matrix compares across tiers). Grader-session cost is per session under clocks.grading.

pricingSource.description: Where the prices were read, with date.

grading.description: Grading outcome pointers (D3). The grader report itself validates against benchmarks/tools/social-messenger/grader/grader-report.schema.json.

graderReportPath.description: Path to the grader report; null only when every grading attempt aborted.

graderFamily.description: The grading model family actually used, normally the other scored family (D5); for Kimi/Grok builders the wave-chosen scored family.

sameFamilyGraded.description: True when the lane was regraded by the builder's own family under the abort fallback; labeled in the record and any publication (D3.4).

graderAborts.description: Count of grader-abort outcomes across grading sessions.

usableGradingRecord.description: False on the dual-abort outcome: O-dimensions record null, the lane is excluded from claim statistics (still reported), and no weighted total or L4 eligibility exists regardless of applicability.

performanceProbes.description: Rotated performance-probe results at the log's checkpoint sizes (10%, 50%, 100%), plus the O5 band inputs. O5 maps deterministically from the frozen invariants - never from perceived speed; absolute latencies publish as diagnostics only.

outcome.description: Probes whose target behavior a failed milestone never built score under the preregistered rule frozen with the probe set: not-passed or excluded-with-note.

k.description: Sample count (contract: 20 requests after 3 warm-ups, sequential, 30 s timeout).

ceilingMs.description: The P3-frozen absolute ceiling for this probe.

ceilingUtilization.description: p95Ms / ceilingMs; O5's 90 band requires <=0.5 for every probe.

anchor.description: True for the category's unchanged cross-wave anchor probe - a non-scored continuity diagnostic that never bears on O3/O5.

o5Inputs.description: The exact inputs to O5's band function, in first-match order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75.

invariantManifestConforms.description: End state verified against the log's invariant manifest via settle-receipt accounting plus the hidden seeded deterministic sample; a nonconforming end state (including a named O5 fixture mismatch at any checkpoint) caps O5 at 0.

namedFixtureChecks.description: Exact pre-probe checks at each checkpoint: probe user's 500 follows, the 5-follow comparison user's count, the busy group's 50-member roster. Keys are checkpoint labels; values true/false.

degradationRules.description: Pass/fail per hardware-independent degradation rule (the measurable p95 predicates over k=20 samples are frozen with the probe set).

deepPaging.description: p95 of page 50 of the 10k-message chat <= 3x p95 of page 1.

feedFollowScaling.description: Following-feed load for the 500-follow probe user <= 3x the 5-follow user.

searchScaling.description: Global search at full corpus <= 3x the 10% checkpoint, 50% on or below the line between them.

receiptAggregation.description: Receipt aggregation in the 50-member group does not visibly stall send/render.

coldStartSync.description: Cold-start initial sync of the 100-conversation probe user completes without timeout or unbounded memory growth; wall time recorded.

noTimeoutErrorOom.description: No probe timed out, errored, or OOMed at the envelope.

o5Band.description: The resulting band, first-match in the order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75; null when the replay was never attempted.

probeSet.description: Holdout-probe custody for the wave (D3.5): the probe-set file is committed as a sha256 hash before the wave's first lane starts, published after the wave, rotated for the next.

sha256Commitment.description: The pre-wave hash commitment (also in the wave record and probes/rotation-log.md).

wave.description: Wave identifier the commitment belongs to.

publishedPath.description: Path to the published probe set after the wave; null while the wave is open.

tokenCounts.description: Harness-native per-turn token usage. input is fresh uncached input; output is the native output total; cacheRead/cacheWrite and the reasoning subset are recorded separately. The cap sum is input + output only, so cache counters are excluded and reasoning is not double-counted. Nulls record an un-metered phase honestly, per benchmarks/protocol.md.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning/thinking-token subset where surfaced; null otherwise. This is included in output by the native harness and is never added to the cap sum a second time.

firstProductEditSnapshot.description: The explicit first-product-edit boundary receipt required by LLP 0295 D0.6: exact orientation bytes and selected skills from the driver, plus the harness-native usage prefix at that timestamp. No transcript heuristic or provider estimator may fill this field.

at.description: Driver-stamped instant immediately before the first product edit; null when no marker was retained.

orientationBytes.description: Exact bytes loaded before the first product edit, measured by the lane driver; null when unmeasured.

selectedSkills.description: Skills selected before the first product edit, in driver-observed selection order.

milestoneRecord.description: One milestone's execution record. Status semantics per the brief's Statuses paragraph. Scoring DAG: M2<-M1, M3<-M1 (M3 does not require M2), M4<-M3, M5<-M3, M6<-M2+M3+M4+M5, M7<-M6, M8<-M6. Reduced-run protocol still executes M1 then M2 then M3; skipping M2 is non-conforming.

status.description: Execution-time status. green: harness-recorded passing suite run (coverage-validated) plus passing choreography segment. capability-failure: cap exhausted; the lane proceeds to the next non-blocked milestone. aborted: abandoned mid-attempt before cap exhaustion - treated as a capability failure for proceed/completeness purposes, distinct in the record. blocked: a prerequisite failed (the brief's blocked-by-M{n}; blockedBy carries the set, lowest member is the headline n). not-run: the lane terminated before reaching it. Do not invent a second green label such as 'functionally green'; copy nonGreenCause from the choreography segment-summary instead.

nonGreenCause.description: Copy of the choreography segment-summary nonGreenCause. Optional; default null when omitted or when status is green. Lanes MUST copy this field rather than inventing 'functionally green'. Closed values: suite-failed, choreography-failed, required-unimplemented, instrument.

blockedBy.description: Required when status is blocked: the complete failed-prerequisite set, including the transitive failed set when a prerequisite was itself blocked. Never counted as an additional independent capability failure.

authoring.description: The milestone's authoring clock. It stops when the harness records both a passing coverage-validated suite run AND a passing run of the milestone's choreography segment; the green receipt is a neutral harness artifact, not a builder assertion. Grader execution, replay, and the M7 session never charge here.

firstGreenAt.description: Per-milestone first-green timestamp (generalizes LLP 0198 P0.0(b)); null when the milestone never went green.

suitePassAt.description: Timestamp of the passing coverage-validated suite run.

choreoPassAt.description: Timestamp of the passing choreography-segment run.

terminalAt.description: Driver-stamped terminal boundary for this attempt: first green, token/wall cap, or abort. Null only for blocked/not-run milestones.

terminalSequence.description: Lane-global driver sequence ordering attempted milestone terminal boundaries independently of wall-clock adjustment.

caps.description: The caps in force for this milestone (wall keyed by milestone; tokens keyed by (cap family, milestone); pilot-calibrated at P3). Advisory families record tokenCap null (inapplicable).

charging.description: Charged figures per LLP 0201 D2 / the brief's Charging rule: wall-exhausted capability-failure charges the full wall cap plus actual tokens (flag capped-wall); token-exhausted charges the token cap plus actual wall (flag capped-tokens); aborted charges the full wall cap plus actual tokens (flag aborted - the abort never improves the capped axis). An adjudicated milestone's published authoring wall recharges to its cap. Green milestones charge actuals with no flags.

flags.description: Empty for green milestones charged at actuals.

adjudication.description: Grading-time adjudication (dishonest coverage mapping): scoring-only and non-retroactive - execution-time statuses, dependencies, termination history, and other milestones' clocks stand as run; the published authoring wall recharges this milestone to its cap; O1 scores its checklist not-passed.
